issuing_body: Minnesota District Court, Hennepin County (complaint published by Minnesota Attorney General)
title: State of Minnesota v. East African Healthcare Network et al., Minnesota False Claims Act complaint

acquisition.channel: Official Minnesota Attorney General document host

supports: Complaint paragraphs 1–3 allege a child nutrition reimbursement scheme involving EAHN and named vendors; claims are allegations, not findings.

Complaint paragraph 2 (PDF page 2) describes more than $10 million in reimbursements received by EAHN with vendors across SFSP/CACFP programs during 2020–2022; the figure is part of the state's allegations.
The complaint distinguishes PIN-sponsored periods, when PIN submitted the reimbursement claims, from EAHN's own sponsorship, when EAHN submitted them.
Complaint paragraph 83 and its table (PDF page 20) list 2,268,484 SFSP meal claims and $7,400,051.15 total payments for PIN-sponsored EAHN sites from July 2020 to September 2021.
The complaint's PDF page 41 table lists 545,324 CACFP meal claims and $1,341,497.04 total payments for PIN-sponsored EAHN sites from September to December 2021.
does_not_support: A civil finding of liability, conviction, final monetary judgment, restitution or collection.
Adding the table amounts to the complaint's >$10 million broad reimbursement figure.
A verified court case number: the public copy carries a blank Court File No. field.
notes: Hennepin complaint's published PDF has no filled case number. Source captures allegations and amounts as pleaded, not court findings; independent source data and current docket status should be acquired.
